title: MVP closure: games, streaming runtime, diagnostics and recovery
objective: Close the usable MVP with on-demand RetroArch, optional Firefox ESR kiosk runtime, diagnostics, recovery and Debian package/update flow.
constraints: RetroArch launches only on demand and returns to the Shell cleanly.
Commercial streaming uses official browser/runtime capabilities only; no DRM bypass is promised.
High-risk helpers remain isolated and cannot execute arbitrary Shell commands.
non_goals: Smart Organizer, llama.cpp and local AI
4K and additional emulator systems outside the selected baseline
acceptance: RetroArch launches supported 8/16-bit systems on demand and returns cleanly to Home.
ROM library classification uses deterministic extension/hash/database logic before any AI.
Provider processes are isolated and cannot execute arbitrary shell through the Shell process.
Firefox ESR streaming runtime launches per-service kiosk sessions on demand and terminates on exit.
A generic browser is not required by the default image.
Diagnostics report CPU, RAM, zram, disk, network, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, PipeWire, display, VA-API, mpv, input, systemd services and cgroups.
Recovery supports restart Shell, reset UI configuration, diagnostics, update recovery when available, reboot and power off.
The Debian package and controlled APT configuration can be built and smoke-tested from a clean environment.

history.reason: Roadmap outcome defined; acceptance may be amended before LOCKED.
P04 reconciled to MVP closure; post-MVP features remain excluded.
Games, diagnostics, recovery and packaging closure proceed with host gates.
